**Claude Buddy is now Orbweaver.** This is the first release under the new name. The app, installers, data folder, hook scripts and speech engine are all renamed, and an upgrade carries your settings across from Claude Buddy automatically. This release also adds orbs for Claude Code sessions hosted by Claude Desktop, and a one-click fix for chat messages Claude Code holds back. It includes a round of reliability fixes too, the biggest of which is for Windows hooks.

## New

- **The rename.** The app is `Orbweaver.app` on macOS and Orbweaver in the Start Menu on Windows. On first launch, your settings and logs move from the old `ClaudeBuddy` folder to an `Orbweaver` one. Hooks are rewired under their new names, and the old ones are removed. Sessions that were already running when you upgraded keep showing up while they finish.
- **Orbs for Claude Code sessions hosted by Claude Desktop.** Desktop's own Claude Code sessions get orbs like terminal sessions do. Their chat panel can send into a Desktop chat bridged over Remote Control.
- **Chat messages that Claude Code held back now have a one-click fix.** When a session runs without permission prompts, Claude Code holds a message from Orbweaver until someone approves it in that session, so chatting from the orb seemed to do nothing. The chat panel now says why, and offers **Let orbs message sessions directly**. Confirm it once and Orbweaver turns on Claude Code's `crossSessionInbound` setting for you, after backing up your `settings.json`. You can then send the held message again without retyping it. The same switch is in **Settings → Claude Code**, where you can also turn it back off.
- **Ending a background job's orb stops the job** through its daemon, instead of leaving it running.
- **The turn-finished voice summary is capped at three sentences**, and it's billed to the account the session runs under.

## Fixed

- **Windows hooks no longer hang on long transcript lines.**
- **macOS stops asking for keychain access over and over.** Credentials are cached, and an unexpired cached login keeps being used when the keychain's timestamp changes.
- **Adding a Claude Code profile says so when its hooks couldn't be wired**, instead of failing silently. The old `--auto-color` flag is no longer passed.
- **The New chat dialog no longer warns "no hooks" on Windows machines that are wired.**

Behind the scenes there's more test hardening on both platforms, including a chat-panel test that could deadlock under coverage.

## Upgrading from Claude Buddy

Install Orbweaver over Claude Buddy as usual. You don't need to uninstall first.

- **macOS: re-grant Automation and Local Network.** Installing replaces `Claude Buddy.app` with `Orbweaver.app` and moves the old app to the Trash on first launch. macOS doesn't carry either permission over to the new app. Without Automation, click-to-focus stops working. Without Local Network, nothing on your LAN can be reached, such as an OpenClaw gateway or a remote-control peer. Re-grant both in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
- **macOS: re-add Orbweaver to Login Items** if Claude Buddy was in them.
- **Codex will ask you to review its hooks again**, because their file changed. Codex runs no hook until you accept.
- **Windows:** the installer removes the old Start Menu group and Startup shortcut.
- If you go back to Claude Buddy, it runs on a snapshot of your settings. Settings you change while downgraded don't carry forward when you upgrade again.

## Known limitations

- The one-click chat fix for held messages applies to sessions on this machine. It isn't offered for a far machine's sessions over the peer link, or for Claude Desktop sessions over Remote Control. Whether Claude Code on Windows can take messages this way at all hasn't been confirmed. The Settings switch works on both platforms.
- A per-user Windows install adds no firewall rule for the peer link, because that needs admin rights. Windows asks the first time Orbweaver listens.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Orbweaver-0.5.11-beta-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Orbweaver-0.5.11-beta-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `Orbweaver-0.5.11-beta-win-x64-setup.exe` |

The `OrbweaverSpeech-*.zip` files are the optional neural speech engine. The app downloads the one it needs, so you don't need to.
